sources.title: ResNet50 - PyTorch
sources.snippet: The ResNet50 v1.5 model is a modified version of the original ResNet50 v1 model. The difference between v1 and v1.5 is that, in the bottleneck blocks which requires downsampling, v1 has stride = 2 in the first 1×1 convolution, whereas v1.5 has stride = 2 in the 3×3 convolution.
